name: Selected-splat Collision Mesh Generation
definition: A standalone smooth 3D voxel mesher for selected splats, generating a collision mesh with perimeter walls and a ceiling. It rasterizes selected splat centers into a sparse 3D grid, preserving separate height layers, floating blobs, and overhangs, then adds solid walls along the perimeter and holes of the selected horizontal footprint, plus a ceiling over that footprint.
summary: Selected-splat Collision Mesh Generation converts user-selected 3D Gaussian splats into watertight collision meshes by rasterizing centers into a sparse grid and explicitly constructing boundary walls and ceilings.
